maria (sec): heads-up — CI Snyk scan flagged a file in partner-backups bucket containing a KMS-wrapped blob that references a partner service account id. not sure if private key material leaked, but audit shows an odd GetObject from a strange runner yesterday :eyes:
lee (infra): can you paste the object path and the logged principal?
maria (sec): gs://partner-backups/2026-03-22/backup-enc.bin; audit says principal: projects/runner-svcaccounts/agents/runner-8472 (non-standard)
sam (oncall): who spun up that runner? tagging @olga since platform schedules ephemeral runners for partner imports.
olga (platform): checking. last deploy for partner import job was 03/21 22:18 by ci-bot. runner id matches ephemeral pool-12, created via terraform module partner-ingest-runner.
maria (sec): the blob metadata includes ciphertext header: `KMS:projects/redwood-kms/locations/us-west1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-2026-01`
lee (infra): ok so wrapped with our KMS key but object stored in partner bucket. blast radius: partner can read object, but they don't have KMS decrypt unless granted. need to verify key ACLs.
vault-bot: Detected: vault-kms-sync job last ran 2026-03-17. No recent policy changes logged for key wrap-2026-01.
sam (oncall): action plan idea: 1) snapshot and quarantine object 2) audit KMS IAM 3) rotate wrapping key or rewrap ciphertext 4) rotate any potentially affected service tokens and partner tokens 5) update runbook and RBAC
maria (sec): +1. also enable key-level audit forwarding to longterm-audit for 90d so we can trace any misuse.
olga (platform): can we avoid full rekey if partner never had decrypt perms? we could rewrap to a new key to be safe and revoke grants to ephemeral runner service account.
lee (infra): steps I'm going to run now: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy wrap-2026-01 --location=us-west1 --keyring=partners` then cross-check members. will post findings.
maria (sec): if any `serviceAccount:runner@partner` or third-party present, escalate immediately.
infra-ci-bot: pipeline #4821 triggered: kms-iam-audit-check (lee)
lee (infra): initial result: IAM shows bindings: cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> serviceAccount:ci-bot@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com; no partner SA. but I do see `roles/cloudkms.admin` for group infra-admins.
sam (oncall): ok good. does not look like partner could decrypt. still want rotation to remove uncertainty. suggest rewrap -> create new key `wrap-2026-02` with limited grants and re-encrypt blob in quarantined bucket.
maria (sec): agree. also run a secrets hunt for any tokens referenced near the same commit window. I will kick off leak-scan on the repo and search for `wrap-2026-01` string. ETA 30m.
olga (platform): I'll schedule a brief maintenance window to rewrap and update policy. propose 04:00 UTC (low traffic) — anyone object?
sam (oncall): fine. i'll be on call for the window. maria, can you own rotation verification (audit + smoke tests)?
maria (sec): i'll own verification and post-checklist. lee, please prepare a terraform change to create wrap-2026-02 and a minimal grant for the rewrap job.
lee (infra): will open PR: `infra/kms/2026-03-rewrap` with plan to create key and add a single serviceAccount:rewrap-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com binding.
maria (sec): also updating RBAC: remove ephemeral-runner SA from any direct KMS grants asap.
sam (oncall): runbook items: 
- snapshot object to quarantine: gsutil cp "gs://partner-backups/.../backup-enc.bin" gs://quarantine-temp/
- create new key and limit IAM
- run rewrap: \`gcloud kms keys versions create- import-rewrap -> gcloud kms encrypt/decrypt flow\` (ops doc in PR)
- rotate any exposed tokens discovered by repo scan
- enable key audit log sink to longterm-audit
maria (sec): i'll also open an incident ticket (INC-2026-03-22-01) for tracking and run the credentials rotation playbook if repo scan returns hits.
lee (infra): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1892 — includes tf plan and rewrap-runner SA. please review.
olga (platform): assigning olga -> infra-review, maria -> sec-review, sam -> oncall-approve.
sam (oncall): after rewrap, run a smoke decrypt test against a staging wrapped artifact to ensure re-encryption worked and KV-cache-driven inference jobs unaffected.
maria (sec): note for compliance: when we rewrap, record key version used and store rewrap manifest in vault at `secret/incidents/INC-2026-03-22/rewrap-manifest` (access: sec+oncall).
vault-bot: vault write secret/incidents/INC-2026-03-22/rewrap-manifest created by maria (sec) at 6734568005
maria (sec): final checklist for rotation window: 1) create wrap-2026-02 (lee) 2) quarantine copy (sam) 3) rewrap blob (lee/olga) 4) smoke decrypt (sam) 5) repo leak scan results (maria) 6) revoke any ephemeral grants (lee) 7) forward key audit logs (olga)
lee (infra): will do. PR reviewed and merging after green tests.
maria (sec): thanks team. post-mortem: once incident ticket closed, update partner onboarding checklist to verify no partner buckets are used for archive of KMS-wrapped material; require internal-only storage or dedicated key per partner.
sam (oncall): noted. closing thread for now — follow-ups in INC-2026-03-22-01. :thumbsup:
